mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM "user" WHERE created_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days} days') AND status != 'deleted' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY date

SELECT TO_CHAR(last_login_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as count FROM "user" WHERE last_login_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days} days') AND last_login_at IS NOT NULL AND status != 'deleted' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(last_login_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY date
SELECT account_type as accountType, COUNT(*) as count FROM "user" WHERE status != 'deleted' GROUP BY account_type
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM "user" GROUP BY status
